text: A young man stands in his bedroom. It just so happens that today, the 13th of April, 2009, is this young man's birthday. Though it was thirteen years ago he was given life, it is only today he will be given a name!
What will the name of this young man be?
alt: A young man stands in his bedroom. He is drawn somewhat simply: monochromatic (aside from a green slime ghost on his shirt), square glasses, stubby, and lacking any arms.
